top_violation_types.title: Director - Multi-Site Operations (26 TAC §744.1003(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not submitted all required documentation for a site director.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §744.1301(a)(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers who are still in their 90 days and have not completed first aid training were observed driving a bus and were alone with the children.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §744.1103(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 4 staff did not have completed affidavits.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §744.1301(a)(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three caregivers did not have CPR/ First Aid in their file.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §744.3559(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that the drills were not documented.

top_violation_types.title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior (26 TAC §744.2103(b)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A carregiver did not use positive statements in the redirection of a child. The caregiver responded to a crying child who was being disciplined by telling him she was "glad that he was crying".  This was corrected at inspection when the person in charge reprimanded the caregiver. The caregiver was sent home due to an inactive background status.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §744.2105(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver yelled at the children, instructing them to remain silent and keep still.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know how many children responsible for (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not know the number of children they were caring for during the inspection.
